peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is PBS the same as saline solution?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The reason for using PBS instead of ordinary saline is that it provides a constant pH. Saline can keep cells isotonic but has no buffering capacity; its pH changes with the conditions of the experiment. PBS contains phosphate buffers which maintain a constant pH, usually at 7.4.Aug 13, 2024
